summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 57 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI’s Fog of War + Betting on Iran + Hard Fork Review of Slop
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ghanain man pleads guilty to role in $100 million fraud ring
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
